note: Provider DEFINITIONS + Dataset RAG governance. Training is never performed from this registry regardless of any field here (services/training/dataset_builder.py structurally never reads it) — see training_disabled_globally. A dataset is fetched into the separate, clearly-labeled 'oyster_dataset_eval' RAG collection ONLY when its OWN record sets rag_eligible=true AND review_status starts with 'reviewed' — both are set by a human operator reviewing the card, never inferred automatically. On 2026-07-25 the operator reviewed fenrir-v2.1 and trendyol-cyber-instruct (Apache-2.0, no card restriction beyond dedup) and approved them for capped, deduped, secret-scanned Dataset RAG ingestion; see rag_ingestion_notes on each. The other six remain not-reviewed and rag_eligible=false — two (cybersecurityeval, purplellama-cyberseceval) have cards that restrict use to held-out evaluation and must never be ingested as RAG content; two (maldict, datadog-malicious-packages) are malware-adjacent and are not auto-fetched even though their labels/metadata are Apache-2.0; one (ctf-dojo) is CC-BY-NC-4.0 (NonCommercial), which the licensing policy resolves to manual_confirm, not auto-use; one (blackhat-kali-instruct) requires full manual row review before any use per its own card.

items.name: Cybersecurity Dataset Fenrir v2.1
items.permitted_use: Reviewed evaluation or, later, reviewed RAG grounding of defensive cybersecurity Q&A. Broad coverage (OWASP, ATT&CK, NIST, cloud, IR, AI security) with refusal/safety examples.
items.licence: Apache-2.0 (per dataset card — reconfirm before use).
items.redistribution: permitted under Apache-2.0 with notice; do not redistribute derived Oyster indexes without attribution.
items.pii_or_sensitive_data: low-expected; manual spot-check required before any storage.
items.content_risk: medium — mostly defensive; offensive snippets must be risk-classified.
items.rag_ingestion_notes: Apache-2.0, no card restriction beyond general use. Ingested as a capped sample (config.DATASET_MAX_ROWS) into the dedicated oyster_dataset_eval collection — never blended into curated Knowledge Packs or project RAG. Every row passes injection neutralization + the shared secret/PII scanner (rows tripping it are dropped, not stored); exact-duplicate rows are dropped both within this dataset and against every other installed dataset (addresses known conceptual overlap with trendyol-cyber-instruct). Citations are labeled source_type='dataset' with an explicit 'not an authoritative source' disclaimer. Still training_eligibility=prohibited — this dataset never enters services/training/.

items.name: Trendyol Cybersecurity Instruction Tuning Dataset
items.permitted_use: Reviewed evaluation of defensive reasoning (SOC, TI, IR, cloud, identity). Substantial conceptual overlap with Fenrir — dedup before combining.
items.licence: Apache-2.0 (per dataset card — reconfirm before use).
items.rag_ingestion_notes: Apache-2.0, no card restriction beyond general use. Same capped/deduped/secret-scanned pipeline and isolated collection as fenrir-v2.1; cross-dataset dedup runs against fenrir-v2.1's already-ingested rows. Still training_eligibility=prohibited — never enters services/training/.

items.name: BlackHat Kali Linux Cybersecurity Dataset (Instruct)
items.permitted_use: Reviewed evaluation of Kali tool terminology/instruction style. Small (434 rows / 261 EN) — inspect EVERY row; high error/outdated-syntax risk.
items.licence: Apache-2.0 (per dataset card — reconfirm before use).
items.content_risk: high — offensive tooling; every row must be risk-classified and scoped.

items.name: CyberSecurityEval
items.permitted_use: HELD-OUT EVALUATION ONLY. The card states 'NOT FOR TRAINING'.
items.training_eligibility: forbidden — must never enter any training or fine-tuning corpus.
items.evaluation_eligibility: allowed (held out; never contaminate other corpora).
items.redistribution: do not redistribute; reference by link.
items.rag_ingestion_notes: Card restricts use to HELD-OUT EVALUATION ONLY. Ingesting into a searchable RAG index would exceed that permitted use, not just repeat it — never fetched.

items.name: Meta PurpleLlama — CyberSecEval
items.permitted_use: Benchmark tooling for assessing LLM cybersecurity behaviour (insecure-code, prompt-injection, cyber-attack helpfulness). Evaluation harness only.
items.licence: See PurpleLlama repo (mixed; confirm per component).
items.content_risk: medium — contains attack prompts for measurement.
items.rag_ingestion_notes: Evaluation harness only per upstream terms — never fetched into RAG.

items.name: MalDICT — Malware Dataset (metadata/labels)
items.permitted_use: Reviewed evaluation / detection-engineering reference using LABELS and metadata (behavior, platform, exploited vuln, packer). Ingest reports/labels only — never raw samples.
items.licence: Apache-2.0 (metadata/labels; published PE samples are disarmed).
items.evaluation_eligibility: allowed for detection/triage eval using metadata only.
items.redistribution: labels/metadata under Apache-2.0; DO NOT redistribute samples.
items.content_risk: high — malware-adjacent; NEVER execute or import samples on the host.
items.rag_ingestion_notes: Not on Hugging Face (GitHub repo of labels/metadata) and not covered by the HF-based Dataset RAG connector; even labels-only ingestion needs a dedicated human-reviewed connector, not auto-fetch.

items.name: DataDog Malicious Software Packages Dataset
items.permitted_use: Reviewed supply-chain detection reference using human-triaged METADATA and static analysis only. Repository explicitly warns it contains ACTIVE malicious software.
items.evaluation_eligibility: allowed for supply-chain detection eval using metadata/manifests only.
items.redistribution: metadata under Apache-2.0; NEVER redistribute or install the packages.
items.content_risk: critical — live malicious packages; never execute, import, or install.
items.rag_ingestion_notes: Not on Hugging Face; repository contains ACTIVE malicious software by design. Never auto-fetched under any circumstance.

items.name: Amazon Science CTF-Dojo
items.permitted_use: Agent-evaluation environment for vulnerability-finding via CTF challenges. Run only in a disposable, isolated lab.
items.licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0 — NonCommercial; unsuitable for unrestricted commercial use without review.
items.evaluation_eligibility: allowed for agent eval in isolated labs after licence review.
items.rag_ingestion_notes: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (NonCommercial) resolves to manual_confirm under the licensing policy — never auto-fetched.
